steps.now: The palace needs a ticket booked online in your own name. Ask 王阿姨 at home — she books everything on her phone.
Go to 天安门 (line 1 to 天安门东), cross the bridge and walk through the gate; show your passport at the security check.
Walk north through 午门 to the Hall of Supreme Harmony 太和殿.
兔儿爷 feels the last spirit at the Nine-Dragon Screen 九龙壁, east of 太和殿's square.
Walk to the Imperial Garden 御花园 — west of 太和殿's square. The spirits are waiting for you there.
